verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own marketing says busywork can be 'described once, done automatically,' and AI Close uses AI agents to reconcile accounts and review transactions; custom categorization rules and auto-categorization add rule-based automation. However, the evidence never documents how users configure these automations, whether they run on a recurring schedule or triggers, or how they run unattended in the background, and outputs are 'reviewed by you before anything's final.' Missing for 10: documented automation setup and configuration, evidence of recurring or trigger-based background execution rather than one-off runs, depth beyond the custom-rules title, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
